summary: A forum thread on the NVIDIA Developer Forums where user andrew.cra2019 asks why running the dustynv ROS2 Galactic Docker image on a Jetson Nano 4GB (JetPack 4.6.3) printed only setup output and dropped into a container shell without the usual download. Dusty_nv replies that the container was already running or already cached, so nothing was re-fetched. The user also tried building from source with jetson-containers, which failed because the base image nvcr.io/nvidia/l4t-base:r32.7.3 was not found; they suspected a premature upgrade from r32.7.1 to r32.7.3 caused the problem. The topic was auto-closed in January 2023.
one_line: Forum thread on a Jetson Nano failing to run the ROS2 Galactic Docker image after a JetPack upgrade, with a missing L4T base image.
key_facts: The user runs a Jetson Nano 4GB, Model B01, on JetPack-SDK-4.6.3, upgraded from 4.6.1.
The user ran docker_run.sh with CONTAINER_IMAGE set to dustynv/ros:galactic-pytorch-l4t-r32.7.1.
The docker_run.sh output ended at root@rosnet:/# followed by exit, with no download step shown.
The user noticed that the usual download and fetch did not happen when running the image.
Building from source with sudo ./scripts/docker_build_ros.sh --distro galactic --package desktop --with-pytorch reported L4T BSP Version R32.7.3.
The source build failed at Step 2/35 with the error: manifest for nvcr.io/nvidia/l4t-base:r32.7.3 not found: manifest unknown.
The user believed the update from r32.7.1 to r32.7.3 was premature and broke the setup.
Dusty_nv replied on December 16, 2022 that the container was already running or already downloaded, which explained why nothing was fetched.
The thread was automatically closed on January 4, 2023, 14 days after the last reply.
